summary: Bug Fix Verified: Job line items sync working correctly. Jobs created with manually typed line_items now persist and display properly on Job Details page. Invoice creation from job includes all line items. All 10 backend tests passed. Frontend UI testing confirmed job creation (Jobs page), line item visibility on Job Details, and invoice creation with line items.

Job creation with manual line_items (Job.description: Creating job with manually typed line_items persists items and shows them on Job Details

Job creation via Save & Add Job path.description: Jobs created from Customers page with line_items show items correctly

Quote to Job approval with line_items.description: Line items persist after quote approval and are visible on Job Details

GET /api/jobs/{job_id}/details returns j.description: Job details API returns synced job_items from embedded line_items

GET /api/jobs/{job_id}/items returns syn.description: Direct items endpoint returns synced items for jobs with embedded line_items

POST /api/invoices/from-job/{job_id} inc.description: Invoice created from job includes all line items with correct descriptions, quantities, and totals

No duplicate line items on repeated read.description: Multiple calls to /details and /items do not create duplicate items

Edit job item after sync.description: Synced job items can be edited with description, quantity, and price changes

Delete job item after sync.description: Synced job items can be deleted without affecting other items

Pricing calculator items persist.description: Items with pricing_category and cost_snapshot from calculator persist correctly

Update job line_items resyncs.description: Updating job with new line_items replaces old items with new synced items

critical_code_review_comments: sync_job_items_from_embedded_line_items() in jobs.py correctly handles the sync from embedded line_items to job_items collection
replace_existing=True parameter properly removes old items before inserting new ones to prevent duplicates
create_job() calls sync after insert to ensure items are available immediately
update_job() with line_items triggers resync to keep collections in sync
create_invoice_from_job() uses sync_job_items_from_embedded_line_items() to populate invoice line_items

success_rate.frontend: 100% (job creation, line item display, invoice creation verified)

seed_data_creation: Test jobs created with TEST_ prefix during testing, cleaned up by test teardown
context_for_next_testing_agent: Job line items sync bug is fixed.
